name: Form Process Quality Control

actor_permissions.conditions: Checked By toggle hanya interaktif untuk role Supervisor

business_logic: 1. Load local process_quality_control_record by id beserta seluruh process_quality_control_detail rows yang ada (0..24), diurutkan berdasarkan urutan kanonis time_slot
2. Populate header form: Process QC ID, Note, Checked By/Acknowledged By dari record; Tanggal auto-fill sekali dengan waktu lokal saat ini HANYA jika record.date masih kosong (draft baru)
3. On 'Tambah baris' → push satu baris kosong baru ke state lokal (belum ter-INSERT ke DB)

4. On 'Hapus baris' → baris dengan id (sudah tersimpan) di-queue ke pendingDeletionIds untuk DELETE saat Simpan/Pause berikutnya; baris tanpa id (baru ditambah sesi ini) langsung dibuang dari state lokal

5. availableTimeSlotOptions(index) → 24 slot kanonis DIKURANGI (slot dipakai baris lain) DAN (slot dengan index kanonis <= index slot TERTINGGI di antara baris lain yang terisi), selalu menyertakan nilai baris itu sendiri

6. On 'Simpan' → validate Process QC ID required (inline error) DAN minimal satu baris valid (Time-Slot terpilih + minimal satu dari 14 kolom bacaan/keterangan, TIDAK termasuk Shift dan QC Inspector ID yang bersifat identitas baris, atau Findings terisi, error khusus pada grid, bukan per-field header)

7. UPDATE header record (status='saved'), lalu applyDetailRowChanges(): upsert baris (id ada → UPDATE, id tidak ada → INSERT dengan id baru) dan DELETE seluruh id di pendingDeletionIds — sequential run() calls, bukan satu transaksi (SQLite lokal, mirrors clarificationRecordRepo.ts/boilerRoomRecordRepo.ts)
8. Navigasi ke Monitor Process Quality Control setelah Simpan sukses
9. On 'Pause' → tanpa validasi wajib apapun, UPDATE header (status='draft_paused') + applyDetailRowChanges() yang sama, navigasi ke Monitor Process Quality Control

10. On 'Clear' → ConfirmDialog; jika confirm: DELETE seluruh process_quality_control_detail rows milik record lalu DELETE header record, navigasi ke Monitor Process Quality Control; jika cancel: tidak ada perubahan

11. On 'Back' → jika form dirty (header atau detailRows atau pendingDeletionIds berubah dari snapshot saat load): tampilkan ConfirmDialog sebelum navigasi; jika tidak dirty: navigasi langsung ke Monitor Process Quality Control
12. checked_by/acknowledged_by role-stripping: checked_by hanya ditulis jika currentUserRole='supervisor', acknowledged_by hanya jika currentUserRole='mill_management'; role lain diabaikan diam-diam

data_operations.description: SELECT 1 record by id beserta seluruh process_quality_control_detail rows
UPDATE header record on Simpan/Pause (status berubah sesuai aksi)
INSERT baris baru (tanpa id) saat Simpan/Pause
UPDATE baris existing (punya id) saat Simpan/Pause
DELETE baris yang di-queue di pendingDeletionIds saat Simpan/Pause, dan seluruh baris record saat Clear
DELETE header record saat Clear dikonfirmasi

edge_case_handling.condition: Process QC ID kosong saat Simpan
edge_case_handling.handling: Error inline pada field Process QC ID, record tidak tersimpan

edge_case_handling.condition: Tidak ada baris Process Quality Control Detail valid saat Simpan
edge_case_handling.handling: ProcessQualityControlDetailRequiredError dilempar oleh repo, error khusus ditampilkan pada grid, record tidak tersimpan; FE juga sudah mem-validasi sebelum memanggil repo (defense-in-depth)

edge_case_handling.condition: Hapus baris yang sudah punya id
edge_case_handling.handling: id di-queue ke pendingDeletionIds, baru benar-benar DELETE saat Simpan/Pause berikutnya; Time-Slot baris tersebut langsung bebas dipakai baris lain

edge_case_handling.condition: Baris hanya terisi Findings saja (atau salah satu dari 14 kolom bacaan/keterangan)
edge_case_handling.handling: Dihitung sebagai baris terisi/valid oleh isRowFilled(), meskipun Shift dan QC Inspector ID kosong

edge_case_handling.condition: Pause ditekan dengan field wajib belum lengkap
edge_case_handling.handling: Tidak ada validasi apapun, field disimpan apa adanya sebagai checkpoint, status=draft_paused
ConfirmDialog wajib dikonfirmasi sebelum penghapusan permanen dijalankan
ConfirmDialog ditampilkan sebelum navigasi keluar tanpa menyimpan

business_rules_applied: Tanggal auto-fill sekali, disabled, tidak dapat diedit manual
Checked By hanya Supervisor, Acknowledged By hanya Mill Management
Grid Process Quality Control Detail dinamis 0..24 baris, ditambah/dihapus satu per satu
Time-Slot tiap baris unik dan urutan menaik kanonis
Minimal satu baris valid sebelum Simpan (tidak berlaku untuk Pause)
Process QC ID wajib diisi sebelum Simpan (tidak berlaku untuk Pause)

unit_test_cases.description: loads an existing draft with its process_quality_control_detail rows in canonical time-slot order
unit_test_cases.given: processQualityControlRecordRepo.getDraftWithDetails(id) returns a record with 3 detail rows stored out of canonical order
unit_test_cases.expect: returned details array is sorted by canonical time-slot order, not insertion/alphabetical order

unit_test_cases.description: auto-fills date only when the loaded record's date is empty
unit_test_cases.given: a brand-new draft record with date=''
unit_test_cases.expect: form.date is set to the current local datetime string; an existing draft with a non-empty date keeps its stored value unchanged

unit_test_cases.description: computes availableTimeSlotOptions excluding slots used by other rows and slots at-or-before the highest used index
unit_test_cases.given: detailRows has 2 other rows using '09:00' and '14:00'
unit_test_cases.expect: options for a new row exclude '09:00', '14:00', and every canonical slot at-or-before '14:00' except the row's own current value

unit_test_cases.description: throws ProcessQualityControlDetailRequiredError when saveDraft is called with zero valid rows
unit_test_cases.given: details array where every row has time_slot null/empty or all 14 reading/keterangan columns (excluding shift and qc_inspector_id) are null
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ProcessQualityControlDetailRequiredError; no DB write occurs

unit_test_cases.description: treats a row with only Findings filled as valid for the minimum-one-row rule, even with shift/qc_inspector_id empty
unit_test_cases.given: one detail row with time_slot='08:00', findings='Perlu ditinjau', shift=null, qc_inspector_id=null, all 12 numeric columns and qc_engineering_corrective_actions null
unit_test_cases.expect: row counts as filled; saveDraft() proceeds without throwing

unit_test_cases.description: saveDraft sets status='saved' and applies upsert/delete for detail rows
unit_test_cases.given: 1 existing row (id present, values changed) + 1 new row (no id) + 1 pendingDeletionIds entry for a previously-existing row
unit_test_cases.expect: header UPDATE sets status='saved'; existing row UPDATEd; new row INSERTed with a generated id; queued id DELETEd

unit_test_cases.description: pauseDraftWithFormData persists as draft_paused without required-field validation
unit_test_cases.given: process_qc_id empty and zero valid detail rows
unit_test_cases.expect: no error thrown; header UPDATEd to status='draft_paused' with fields as-is; detail upsert/delete still applied

unit_test_cases.description: deleteDraft cascades delete to all process_quality_control_detail rows before deleting the header
unit_test_cases.expect: all 4 detail rows DELETEd, then the header record DELETEd

unit_test_cases.description: strips checked_by/acknowledged_by when currentUserRole lacks the matching role
unit_test_cases.given: headerData.checked_by set but currentUserRole='operator'; headerData.acknowledged_by set but currentUserRole='supervisor'
unit_test_cases.expect: persisted checked_by=null and acknowledged_by=null despite headerData values being present

screen_dependencies.reason: Entry point (New Data / lanjutkan draft) dan tujuan navigasi setelah Simpan/Pause/Clear

implementation_notes: Semua operasi lokal di SQLite via processQualityControlRecordRepo.ts, tidak ada panggilan API
processQualityControlRecordRepo.ts mencakup ketiga screen mobile Process Quality Control (070/080/090) dalam satu file, mirrors clarificationRecordRepo.ts/boilerRoomRecordRepo.ts
canonicalTimeSlots() identik dengan clarificationRecordRepo.ts: for i in 0..23 -> hour = (7 + i) % 24, format 'HH:00', dimulai dari 07:00

16 kolom non-time_slot per baris (jumlah kolom bacaan terbanyak di seluruh proyek): Shift (teks bebas, identitas baris), 12 kolom numerik (Fruit Press Oil Loss in Sludge/Fibre, Purifier & Clarification Balance Inlet Temp/Backpressure, Vacuum Drying Station Drier Temp/Vacuum Pressure, Decanter/Centrifuge Feed Rate/Oil Loss in Cake, Final Storage FFA/Moisture Content/Impurities-Dirt/DOBI Index), QC Inspector ID (teks bebas, identitas baris), QC Engineering Corrective Actions (teks bebas, ikut 'filled' check), Findings (teks bebas, ikut 'filled' check) — TANPA kolom enum/status apapun

isRowFilled() mengecek 14 kolom (12 numerik + QC Engineering Corrective Actions + Findings) — Shift dan QC Inspector ID adalah kolom identitas/konteks baris, TIDAK ikut menentukan 'filled', mirrors ProcessWaterRecordService's exclusion of shift/inspector_id
Stasiun ini TIDAK memiliki tabel referensi target operasional — tidak ada CollapsibleSection/read-only reference data pada layar ini

Field urutan pada grid & form mengikuti urutan kolom migration process_quality_control_details persis: Shift → Fruit Press Oil Loss in Sludge → Fruit Press Oil Loss in Fibre → Purifier & Clarification Balance Inlet Temp → Purifier & Clarification Balance Backpressure → Vacuum Drying Station Drier Temp → Vacuum Drying Station Vacuum Pressure → Decanter/Centrifuge Feed Rate → Decanter/Centrifuge Oil Loss in Cake → Final Storage FFA → Final Storage Moisture Content → Final Storage Impurities/Dirt → Final Storage DOBI Index → QC Inspector ID → QC Engineering Corrective Actions → Findings
